paragraphs: Mentioned in Ketubot 111a: he challenged Rabbi Ilaa’s statement, and Abaye answered his challenge. Hyman reports that Yuchasin reads R' Acha.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Acha reading is attributed to Yuchasin; the frozen heading Abba Sala Rabbah is retained.

The whole Davidson paragraph fully writes Rabbi Ilaa and Rabbi Abba Sala Rabba and has Abaye’s answer. These support the local titles and direction. The Acha reading remains Hyman’s uncollated Yuchasin report, so its abbreviated title is retained as R'; the inherited note remains verbatim.
